name: ModelVariant682Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant682us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (strip columns spawn at a tracked model point and fan out as sixteen Gouraud strips, a burst of 32 rays with Gouraud triangles and a spinning sixteen-strip fan, and a grid of animated spark sprites pinned to six model points); for a non-negative request it clears the work area, prints its size, packs three texture images and seeds the columns, burst, fan, sparks and delay from the command row indexed by the request (only command 0 has a timetable); every call then counts down the delay or runs one frame, returning 1 once when the burst starts at frame 143, 2 while every element is inactive and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-699 and 766 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
